components.cost_effect: One HVP per draw; squared-displacement rather than deterministic quadrature-bias accounting.
components.goal: Estimate a gradient difference without same-sample endpoint access.
components.name: Independent uniform line point
components.operation: Choose U independently, query one fresh HVP at x+U(y-x) in direction y-x.
components.requires: Predictable endpoints, derivative-expectation interchange and the linked directional variance conditions.
transfer_checks: Check line-point query permissions and fresh-sample independence.
Do not confuse a robust output with an unbiased sample or a complete optimization algorithm.

limitations.statement: No SOSP stopping rule, curvature search or end-to-end query complexity is provided by this component.
The robust selector need not preserve unbiasedness; its guarantee is norm accuracy with user-selected confidence.

performance_links.scope_note: Formal dependency authority is links[0]; prepare binds its revision. Performance covers only the increment component.

variants.cost: Exactly one fresh HVP per single draw, exactly KR for robust mode; no value or gradient calls. Group averaging, distance comparisons and random draws are arithmetic/randomness, not additional oracle calls.
variants.implementation_details_ref: p.6 Section4.1; pp.11–12 Lemmas A.1/A.3; explicit batching constants in linked local lemma.
variants.name: Single draw or robust increment
variants.output: Y, an unbiased population gradient increment sample; or a robust vector within rho of grad F(y)-grad F(x) with conditional probability >=1-delta. The robust vector is not asserted unbiased.
public_inputs: Finite endpoints x,y, public L1,sigma2, and optionally rho>0,0<delta<1.
variants.query_and_update: Single draw: sample U uniform on[0,1], request Hess f(x+Uh;Z)h with fresh Z, and return Y. Robust mode: K=max(1,ceil(36(sigma2^2+L1^2)||h||^2/rho^2)); independently compute R=max(1,ceil(8log(1/delta))) group averages, each from K independent draws. Return the first average having more than half the averages within distance2rho/3, or the first average if none is admissible.
variants.requirements: Finite-dimensional Euclidean setting and conditional unbiasedness/variance assumptions of the linked fresh-integral lemma; arbitrary line-interior HVP queries are permitted. Endpoints precede every fresh U,Z; U is independent of Z.
variants.state_and_initialization: Before fresh randomness fix x,y and h=y-x. Store no current sample handle. For robust estimation allocate independent groups of fresh draws.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: One draw returns immediately. Robust mode stops after exactly KR HVPs. The constants and log(2/delta) accounting are the explicit local implementation in the linked lemma; no optimization stopping rule is included.

checked_locators: Section4.1 equation(4.1); Lemmas A.1/A.3; linked explicit local implementation
